description: How much will Nvidia's commitments to suppliers (purchase obligations, primarily memory procurement) be at its next annual report, after rising to $279 billion in the second quarter from $119 billion the prior quarter?
outcome: The reported amount of Nvidia's commitments to suppliers / purchase obligations disclosed at its next annual report.
period: Next annual report: Nvidia's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ending late January 2027 (filed in early 2027); set by the rule that an obligation already undertaken is tracked at the next annual report.

description: Will Nvidia complete its announced $12.9 billion acquisition of Hugging Face, the open-source AI model repository, by a check date within 18 months of the September 2026 announcement?
outcome: Whether Nvidia closes (or abandons/restructures) the announced $12.9 billion purchase of Hugging Face, an acquisition that would absorb cash and add a developer-platform asset.
period: Check date within 18 months of the 2026-09-05 item (by approximately 2028-03-05); the item gives no closing date.

description: How much will Nvidia have guaranteed or committed in credit support for AI infrastructure projects at its next annual report, after agreeing in August 2026 to provide guarantees of up to $105 billion for a data center project in Ohio?
outcome: The reported amount of Nvidia's guarantees / credit support for AI infrastructure projects, including the Ohio data center project, disclosed at its next annual report.
period: Next annual report: Nvidia's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ending late January 2027 (filed in early 2027); set by the rule that an obligation already undertaken is tracked at the next annual report.

description: Will the combined capital expenditures of the top five hyperscalers approach $1.3 trillion in calendar 2027, as Nvidia expects?
outcome: The top five hyperscalers' combined reported capital expenditures for calendar 2027.
period: Calendar 2027; checked against the top five hyperscalers' reported 2027 capital expenditures in their quarterly filings and annual reports (early 2028). The item gives the 2027 period.

description: Will Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform, the next-generation system now in production and receiving purchase orders from hyperscalers, account for about 20% of the data center segment's revenue in fiscal Q3 2027, as management guided?
outcome: Vera Rubin's share of Nvidia's data center segment revenue in fiscal Q3 2027 (the quarter management guided to roughly 20%).
period: Fiscal Q3 2027 (quarter ending late October 2026), reported around November 2026; the item states management expects about 20% of data center segment revenue in that quarter.

description: Will server DRAM prices jump another 260% in calendar 2026, after rising 64% in the second half of 2025, as the item projects?
outcome: The change in server DRAM prices for calendar 2026 versus the prior period, as measured by industry server DRAM price data.
period: Calendar 2026; checked against server DRAM price reports for 2026 (e.g., TrendForce/DRAMeXchange quarterly updates) after the year or in periodic releases. The item states the 2026 projection.

description: How much will Nvidia's commitments for future equity investments in AI and infrastructure companies be at its next annual report, after reporting $25 billion of such commitments at the end of fiscal Q2 2027?
outcome: The reported amount of Nvidia's commitments for future investments at its next annual report.
period: Next annual report: Nvidia's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ending late January 2027 (filed in early 2027); set by the rule that an obligation already undertaken is tracked at the next annual report.

description: Will global high-bandwidth memory (HBM) shipments grow by approximately 50%-60% in calendar 2027, still falling short of demand, as the item projects?
outcome: Global HBM shipment growth and whether HBM supply remains short of demand in calendar 2027.
period: Calendar 2027; checked against HBM shipment data and memory manufacturers' 2027 reports.

description: Will global semiconductor revenue reach roughly $975 billion in calendar 2026, including about $500 billion from AI chip sales, as Deloitte estimates?
outcome: Calendar 2026 global semiconductor industry revenue and the AI-chip portion of it, the aggregate that underpins demand for Nvidia's data center products.
period: Calendar 2026; checked against full-year 2026 semiconductor industry revenue data (e.g., SIA/WSTS annual statistics or Gartner/IDC 2026 revenue releases) published in early 2027. The item gives the 2026 period.

description: Will NAND demand generated by Nvidia's CMX (Context Memory Storage) architecture, the storage tier built around its BlueField-4 DPU for long-context and agentic inference, exceed 100 million TB in calendar 2027, up from a projected 35 million TB in 2026?
outcome: The volume of NAND demand attributable to Nvidia's CMX architecture in calendar 2027, against the item's projection of more than 100 million TB (from 35 million TB in 2026), and whether memory makers' capacity additions keep pace with it.
period: Calendar 2027 with calendar 2026 as base year; settled when full-year 2027 NAND demand/bit-shipment data for CMX are published (early 2028, e.g. TrendForce releases and memory makers' 2027 reports).
